newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares subdued, Valmiera maintains gains.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares subdued, Valmiera maintains gains.

text.p: Latvian shares were in a more subdued mood on Wednesday although new stock Valmiera Glassfibre maintained its gains.
Overall bourse turnover came to 230,000 lats compared with 276,000 and the Rietumu Bank bourse index rose by just 0.42 percent to 185.32.
Valmiera was the most traded share at 51,700 lats as it gained to 2.69 lats from 2.53. Its nominal starting price when it joined the bourse on Monday was one lat.
Official list leader Unibanka was the second most traded stock on turnover of 43,500 lats but was stable at 4.50 lats.
Staburadze confectionery was also well traded on 41,100 lats of turnover as it rose seven to three lats.
Also on the official list, Riga Transport Fleet was unchanged at 1.70 lats on small trade of 8,500 lats.

Daugavpils Chain manfacturer saw trade of 34,500 lats and added five santimes to 2.68 lats, Kaija fish cannery turned over 12,200 lats to rise to 2.35 lats from 2.28 lats while Roja was stable at three lats on trade of 12,700 lats.
